source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Timed Dry fault check (optional)
steps.body: Empty dryer, clean lint screen. Start Timed Dry. If F-22 or F-23 flashes within 60 s and dryer shuts off, thermistor or harness is open/short — disconnect power before bench tests.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Empty dryer, clean lint screen. Start Timed Dry. If F-22 or F-23 flashes within 60 s and dryer shuts off, thermistor or harness is open/short — disconnect power before bench tests.

steps.title: Disconnect P14 at MCE
steps.body: Access MCE. Disconnect P14 connector. Measure thermistor at component or through harness per wiring diagram.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Access MCE. Disconnect P14 connector. Measure thermistor at component or through harness per wiring diagram.

steps.title: Exhaust thermistor resistance
steps.body: Measure exhaust thermistor. ~12 kΩ @ 70°F; 9.2 kΩ @ 80°F; 19.9 kΩ @ 50°F (OEM R/T table). Open → F-22. Short → F-23.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure exhaust thermistor. ~12 kΩ @ 70°F; 9.2 kΩ @ 80°F; 19.9 kΩ @ 50°F (OEM R/T table). Open → F-22. Short → F-23.
